models.name: thermal_comfort_pmv_ppd
models.title: Thermal comfort: Fanger PMV-PPD model
models.summary: Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) and Predicted Percentage of Dissatisfied (PPD) after Fanger (1970): full body heat balance (breathing, perspiration, sweat, clothing, radiation, convection) with the activity and clothing selected from two embedded lookup tables.
models.authors: Sylvain Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); Jean Lebrun (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: building_rc_network_3r2c
models.title: 3R2C building thermal network with weather lookup
models.summary: Single-zone building thermal network with three thermal capacitances (indoor air, opaque facade, internal masonry walls) coupled through thermal resistances, integrated over one week of July weather read from a lookup table; ventilation is the only heat sink (free-running zone).
models.authors: S. Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); TBD (author of the original EES model of the CLIM R06 repetition exercise 2)

models.name: boiler_mean_specific_heat
models.title: Fuel-oil boiler modelled with the mean specific heat of the flue gases (cpbar)
models.summary: Fuel-oil heating boiler represented as a combustor (adiabatic flame temperature from the mean specific heat of the combustion products, routine cpbar of the ULiege combustion library) followed by a gas-to-water eps-NTU exchanger and an envelope-loss term; computes the boiler efficiency.
models.tags: boiler;combustion;fuel oil;mean specific heat;flue gas;eps-NTU;adiabatic flame temperature;on/off control;exercise
models.authors: Sylvain Quoilin (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, CoolSolve example); Jean Lebrun (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES reference model); Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES reference model)

models.name: scroll_compressor_semi_empirical
models.title: Semi-empirical hermetic scroll compressor in a refrigeration cycle
models.summary: Reference model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002) as implemented by V. Lemort: six-step compression path (supply drop, heating-up, isentropic compression to the adapted pressure, isochoric compression, exhaust cooling, exhaust drop) with internal leakage, fictitious-wall heat transfers and electromechanical losses; parameters identified on a Copeland ZR72KC-TFD catalogue, refrigerant cycle reduced to an evaporator and a condenser at imposed saturation temperatures. A simplified variant without leakage (converted from the EES original in bar/kJ units) is included.
models.tags: scroll compressor;semi-empirical;reference model;parameter identification;refrigeration;part load;internal leakage;built-in volume ratio
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002)

models.name: two_stage_steam_compressor_intercooling
models.title: Two-stage compression of superheated steam with intercooling at the optimal intermediate pressure
models.summary: Superheated steam (0.15 kg/s, 100 kPa to 625 kPa, 100 K superheat) is compressed by a two-stage isentropic compressor with intercooling back to the supply temperature, the intermediate pressure being set by the rule of equal stage pressure ratios (the work-minimising choice for ideal gases, Cengel & Boles). The model compares the powers of the single-stage isentropic, two-stage and isothermal (INTEGRAL of v dP) compressors and of a liquid pump, and computes the heats rejected in the intercooler and by the isothermal compression.
models.authors: N. Paulus; B. Dechesne; S. Quoilin (course MECA0002)

models.name: dry_air_screw_compressor_leakage
models.title: Dry air screw compressor with internal leakage
models.summary: Dry (oil-free) screw air compressor between 1 bar / 15 C suction and 3 bar discharge: three parameters identified at the 7000 rpm nominal point (swept volume, mechanical-loss torque, equivalent leakage-throat area) are imposed, and the model predicts the performance at another speed (2000 rpm default) with the leakage flow through a choked equivalent nozzle mixed back into the suction, isentropic internal compression and mechanical losses dissipated to the surroundings.
models.tags: screw compressor;dry air;internal leakage;volumetric efficiency;isentropic efficiency;exercise
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: piston_compressor_identification
models.title: Piston compressor - parameter identification from two operating points
models.summary: Piston air compressor between 1 bar / 15 C suction and 3-10 bar discharge: four parameters (swept volume, clearance factor, constant electromechanical losses, loss factor) identified from two measured operating points (square system) are imposed at their rounded values, and the model predicts the flow rate and power at two new operating points (10 bar at 3000 rpm, 7 bar at 2500 rpm).
models.tags: piston compressor;reciprocating compressor;parameter identification;volumetric efficiency;clearance volume;exercise
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES solution); Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: refrigeration_compressor_identification
models.title: Refrigeration compressor - parameter identification from two operating points
models.summary: R22 reciprocating refrigeration compressor in a vapour-compression cycle (3 K subcooling, 5 K superheat): four parameters (swept volume flow rate, clearance factor, constant electromechanical losses, loss factor) identified from two measured operating points (cooling capacity and power at two condensing/evaporating temperature pairs, square system) are imposed at their rounded values, and the model predicts the cooling capacity and power at a third operating point (40 C condensing, 2 C evaporating).
models.tags: reciprocating compressor;piston compressor;refrigeration compressor;parameter identification;volumetric efficiency;clearance volume;exercise
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES solution); Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: centrifugal_turbocompressor_performance
models.title: Centrifugal turbocompressor performance (air)
models.summary: Air flow rate drawn by a centrifugal turbocompressor (impeller + vaneless diffuser) at constant isentropic efficiencies: velocity triangles at the impeller outlet, Euler equation, diffuser pressure recovery; solves the nominal point and can be swept towards the maximum pressure ratio.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, course Machines et systèmes thermiques, repetition of 2004-10-12, exercise 2; author not identified)

models.name: centrifugal_compressor_lookup_map
models.title: Centrifugal compressor with a lookup-table performance map (air)
models.summary: Constant-speed centrifugal air compressor characterised by a three-point performance map: reduced mass flow rate and isentropic efficiency interpolated from the map at the pressure ratio, then mass flow rate and absorbed power. Native EES INTERPOLATE form (blocked); a runnable variant ships beside it.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège MSTh course — Machines et systèmes thermiques; course team J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio; individual author not identified)

models.name: piston_compressor_suction_drop_leakage
models.title: Piston compressor with inlet pressure drop and internal leakage
models.summary: Two-litre piston air compressor tested at 1500 rpm between 1 bar / 15 C suction and 5 bar discharge with identified overall efficiencies (0.75 / 0.55), dead-volume factor and proportional loss factor: the suction pressure drop and the internal leakage are modelled by equivalent isentropic nozzles whose areas are solved, the leak mixes back into the suction flow and the internal isentropic compression is closed by the clearance-volume volumetric efficiency; meant to be swept over speed.
models.tags: piston compressor;inlet pressure drop;internal leakage;volumetric efficiency;clearance volume;equivalent nozzle;exercise

models.name: centrifugal_compressor_design_similarity
models.title: Centrifugal compressor design and similarity (air)
models.summary: Design of a centrifugal turbocompressor from the flow factor and the enthalpy factor of its best-performance point (dry air, 1 bar / 20 C to 2.5 bar, 6000 m3/h): impeller diameter, rotation speed, tip speed and inlet area. A variant applies the same similarity factors to a compressor of the same type compressing methane.

models.name: scroll_expander_semi_empirical
models.title: Scroll expander semi-empirical model
models.summary: Semi-empirical positive-displacement (scroll) expander: supply throttling and wall heat transfer, isentropic expansion to the built-in (adapted) pressure followed by an isochoric expansion to the exhaust pressure, leakage flow, exhaust wall heat transfer, mechanical losses and global isentropic effectiveness. Originally written as an EES MODULE; the equations are flattened into the main program (library decision D10).

models.name: counterflow_hx_oil_water
models.title: Counterflow heat exchanger - oil cooled by water (effectiveness-NTU)
models.summary: Counterflow heat exchanger cooling an oil of constant specific heat with water, rated with the effectiveness-NTU method: capacity rates, NTU, counterflow effectiveness, outlet temperatures and transferred power.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: condenser_three_zones
models.title: Air-cooled condenser, three-zone parametric model
models.summary: Semi-empirical three-zone model (desuperheating, condensation, subcooling) of an air-cooled R134a condenser with epsilon-NTU laws and flow-rate-fitted conductances; ships the combined crossflow/counterflow configuration plus purely counterflow and purely crossflow variants.

models.name: hx_constant_pinch
models.title: Heat exchanger with an imposed pinch (three zones)
models.summary: Condenser sized by an imposed pinch and subcooling: three refrigerant zones (desuperheating, condensation, subcooling) against a single-phase coolant, with the saturation pressure closed by the pinch condition. Translation of the LaboThapPy HexCstPinch condenser branch.
models.authors: Basile Chaudoir; Elise Neven; Titouan Janod

models.name: crossflow_hx_hot_gas_water
models.title: Crossflow heat exchanger - hot gas heating water (effectiveness-NTU)
models.summary: Crossflow heat exchanger using hot gas of constant specific heat to heat pressurised water, rated with the crossflow effectiveness-NTU method: capacity rates, NTU, effectiveness, transferred power, gas flow rate and required exchange area.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: shell_and_tube_steam_condenser
models.title: 1-2 shell-and-tube steam condenser (effectiveness-NTU)
models.summary: 1-2 shell-and-tube condenser of a steam power plant (30 000 water-cooled tubes, steam at 50 C) rated as a semi-isothermal exchanger with the effectiveness-NTU method: water temperature rise, Colburn-analogy water-side coefficient, overall coefficient and tube length.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: refrigeration_evaporator_wet_coil
models.title: Refrigeration evaporator with moist air, wet regime
models.summary: Air-cooled R134a evaporator of a refrigeration circuit running in the wet regime (condensation on the coil): imposed evaporating and condensing temperatures with superheat, subcooling and isenthalpic expansion on the refrigerant side, imposed air inlet and outlet states on the air side, and a 25 kW duty from which the two flow rates, the fictitious air-side capacity rate and the coil conductance are determined.
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: wet_air_cooled_condenser
models.title: Wet air-cooled condenser (spray evaporative cooling)
models.summary: Air-cooled condenser operating in wet regime (spray evaporation): air side treated as a fictitious dry fluid on wet-bulb temperatures with an effectiveness-NTU closure; given the duty and the air inlet/outlet states, determines AU_f, the fictitious capacity rate, the air flow rate and the spray/condensate water flow.
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: iso5167_orifice_plate_flow_rate
models.title: ISO 5167 orifice plate (diaphragm) flow-rate calculation
models.summary: ISO 5167-1980 flow-rate procedure for a diaphragm (orifice plate with corner tappings): fluid properties at the upstream state (humid air supported), Stolz discharge coefficient and expansibility factor; the default operating point is written inversely and solves the bore diameter from an imposed mass flow rate.
models.tags: orifice plate;diaphragm;ISO 5167;flow metering;flow measurement;instrumentation;corner tappings;Stolz discharge coefficient;humid air

models.name: centrifugal_fan_reference_model
models.title: Centrifugal fan reference model (dimensionless factors)
models.summary: Reference simulation of a centrifugal fan transporting humid air: given the fan geometry (impeller diameter, exhaust area), the rotation speed and the supply state and mass flow rate, the model returns the flow, pressure, isentropic-effectiveness and power factors of the fan, closed on the operating point by two cubic fits in the pressure factor.

models.summary: Reference simulation of a centrifugal pump on a hydraulic network: dimensionless characteristic curves (cubic psi(phi) and Lambda(phi) polynomials) with brine properties from the ULiège BrineProp library; computes pressure rise, shaft power, efficiency and exhaust state.

models.name: dhw_tank_dynamic
models.title: Domestic hot-water storage tank: dynamic temperature evolution
models.summary: Transient energy balance of a fully mixed 500 L domestic hot-water tank over a 5-hour scenario (10 kW heater for 1 h, cooldown, 2 h tap draw with 12 C make-up water, ambient losses), integrated with INTEGRAL and a 1-s step.

models.name: ice_storage_tank_discharge_phase_change
models.title: Ice storage tank discharge with phase change
models.summary: Discharge of a 120 m3 water/ice storage tank through a glycol heat exchanger over 50 000 s: the specific internal energy of the contents is integrated in time (INTEGRAL) and 5-argument IF logic tracks the ice fraction and the tank temperature through subcooled ice, melting at 0 C and liquid warming.

models.name: libr_water_absorption_chiller
models.title: LiBr-water absorption chiller cycle with a solution heat exchanger
models.summary: Single-effect LiBr-H2O absorption chiller at one operating point: solution concentrations from the EES built-in X_LIBR/H_LIBR routines, mass and LiBr conservation for the weak/rich solution flow rates, generator energy balance for the driving heat and the COP, 75 % solution heat exchanger.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège MSTh course: J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio)

models.name: single_cylinder_engine_weibe
models.title: Single-cylinder engine with Weibe combustion (crank-angle dynamic)
models.summary: Crank-angle-resolved model of one cylinder of a four-stroke spark-ignition engine: the cylinder pressure, gas mass, combustion heat release (Weibe function in a PROCEDURE), wall heat losses and piston work are integrated with INTEGRAL over the intake stroke (-360 to -180 deg), with a choked intake flow through the intake valve and the charge modelled as a single ideal gas with constant gamma.

models.name: gas_engine_full_power_cpbar
models.title: Full-power operating point of a 4-stroke gas engine (combustion products with cpbar)
models.summary: Steady-state energy and mass balances of a 4-stroke gas engine at its nominal operating point: throttle, isentropic path from the throttled state to the intake flow state (kinetic-energy balance), combustion in which the products are described by their mean specific heat cpbar (routine of the ULiege combustion library, copied from CSL-0005), isentropic expansion and cooling by the water jacket.

models.name: otto_cycle_air_standard
models.title: Air-standard Otto cycle (ideal gas, variable specific heats)
models.summary: Theoretical Otto cycle solved exactly as the original exercise: air as an ideal gas with a variable specific heat, the ratio of the specific heats gamma evaluated at the mean temperature of each isentropic transformation and c_v held constant over each transformation. It gives the four state points, the maximum pressure and temperature, the net work per unit mass, the thermal efficiency and the work and power of a multi-cylinder engine.

models.name: stirling_cycle_ideal_regenerator
models.title: Ideal Stirling cycle with a perfect regenerator
models.summary: Theoretical Stirling cycle (two isotherms, two isochores) with an ideal regenerator: work and heat of the four transformations, net work, efficiency with and without regenerator compared with the Carnot efficiency. Every quantity is also computed with the real-gas air property functions, and the works of the two isotherms with the EES definite integral of p dv as well as in closed form.

models.name: two_shaft_gas_turbine_compressor_map
models.title: Two-shaft gas turbine with a compressor map and two expanders
models.summary: Steady-state model of a two-shaft gas turbine (single-spool compressor and combustor, two mechanically independent expanders) on air: the compressor is described by a performance map (reduced flow, pressure ratio and isentropic efficiency versus reduced speed), the combustor by an energy balance with the mean specific heats of the ULiege combustion library, and expander 1 by a power balance from which its isentropic efficiency is found. Revision exercise of the ULiege course 'Machines et systemes thermiques', in three parts.

models.name: gas_turbine_two_shaft_intercooled_regenerative
models.title: Land-based two-shaft gas turbine with intercooling, regeneration and reheat
models.summary: Open-circuit two-shaft gas turbine (Brayton cycle) on air as a perfect gas: low-pressure compressor, water-cooled intercooler, high-pressure compressor, regenerator, main combustion chamber, high-pressure turbine driving the compressors, reheat combustion chamber and low-pressure turbine driving an alternator; computes the LP turbine shaft power and the overall efficiency.

models.name: turbojet_ideal_260ms
models.title: Ideal turbojet flying at 260 m/s
models.summary: Air-standard jet-propulsion cycle of an ideal turbojet: isentropic diffuser, compressor (pressure ratio 10), isobaric combustor (turbine inlet 1100 °C), turbine driving only the compressor, isentropic nozzle back to ambient; exhaust velocity and propulsion efficiency.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège MECA0002, S. Quoilin)

models.name: combined_gas_steam_cycle
models.title: Combined gas-steam cycle (Brayton topping cycle, Rankine bottoming cycle)
models.summary: Combined gas-steam cycle: a gas turbine (Brayton) topping cycle on ideal-gas air whose exhaust gases heat a simple Rankine cycle on water in a heat exchanger; computes the steam-to-gas flow ratio of the heat exchanger and the thermal efficiency of the combined cycle.

models.name: gas_turbine_reheat
models.title: Gas turbine with reheat (intercooler and regenerator)
models.summary: Two-shaft ideal-gas air turbine with two compression stages, water-cooled intercooler, regenerator, main combustion chamber, HP turbine driving the compressors, second (reheat) combustion chamber and LP turbine expanding to ambient pressure; computes the extra fuel consumption and the cycle efficiency with reheat.

models.name: orc_simple_r245fa
models.title: Simple ORC with imposed component performance (R245fa)
models.summary: Subcritical R245fa Organic Rankine Cycle for quick performance screening (Quoilin thesis Ch. 5.3): oil-heated evaporator, water-cooled condenser, recuperator, expander and pump with imposed effectivenesses and pinch constraints; computes pressures, state points, net power (14.8 kW) and cycle efficiency (15.7 %).
models.tags: organic Rankine cycle;waste heat recovery;screening;recuperator;imposed effectiveness;pinch
models.authors: S. Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: orc_extraction_r134a
models.title: ORC with two-stage expander and intermediate extraction (R134a)
models.summary: R134a Organic Rankine Cycle (T_ev = 90 °C, T_cd = 30 °C) whose screw/scroll-type expander is described stage by stage: isentropic first expansion, extraction of a fraction of the flow at an intermediate pressure, isentropic second expansion and constant-volume discharge; the extracted vapour is mixed with the exhaust and cools the pumped liquid in an internal heat exchanger. For a specified 5 kW expander power it determines the displaced volume (21.2 cm3), the extracted fraction (13.2 %), the pressures, all state points, a 35.6 kW boiler duty and a cycle efficiency of 11.7 %.
models.authors: S. Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory) — probable, to be confirmed by the maintainer

models.name: orc_co2_polynomial_maps
models.title: Supercritical CO2 ORC with polynomial compressor and turbine performance maps
models.summary: Closed supercritical CO2 (R744) vapour power cycle (cooler, compressor, recuperator, solar air-CO2 heater, turbine, three lossy pipes) in which the compressor and the turbine are described by polynomial fits of their performance maps and run at an imposed speed of 75000 rpm; the maps close the cycle (mass flow rate and turbine exhaust pressure are unknowns): 2.27 kg/s of CO2, 94 kW net, 22.1 % cycle efficiency.
models.tags: organic Rankine cycle;supercritical CO2;transcritical;performance map;polynomial correlation;recuperated cycle;solar thermal;turbomachinery map

models.name: orc_biomass_chp
models.title: Biomass-boiler ORC (R123) with scroll expanders and a split condenser
models.summary: Organic Rankine cycle on R123 heated by a biomass boiler and coupled, through the feed-water loop, to a condenser split in two parts (water cooled then air cooled). The evaporator (liquid/two-phase/vapour zones), the scroll expander (5 machines in parallel, semi-empirical with leakage and wall heat transfer) and the biomass burner (adiabatic combustion, flue-gas and water-to-ambient heat exchangers) are component sub-models, written as EES MODULE/SUBPROGRAM blocks in the original and flattened into the main program here (decision D10): 73.2 kW net, first-law efficiency 0.108 (EES reference solution).

models.name: refrigeration_cycle_simple_compressor
models.title: Refrigeration cycle with a simple compressor model

models.name: heat_pump_cycle_r22_30kw

models.title: High-temperature heat pump with PCM storage (Zorlu geothermal plant case study)

models.summary: Air-to-water heat pump on R410A with evaporator pressure drop: refrigerant flow from the condenser heat balance on the water side, evaporator air flow for a 15 K air cooling, overall COP and compressor isentropic efficiency; zeotropic temperature evaluation under the dome.
models.tags: heat pump;refrigeration;air source;zeotropic fluid;evaporator pressure drop;exercise
models.authors: TBD (ULiège course MECA0002, Thermodynamique appliquée)

models.name: refrigerator_freezer_r134a
models.title: Domestic refrigerator-freezer on R134a with two evaporators
models.summary: Sizing of a domestic fridge-freezer on R134a delivering 1.5 kW of refrigeration at two evaporation temperatures (3 °C for the fridge compartment, -20 °C for the freezer) with one high and two low pressures: computes the compressor outlet temperature, the refrigerant flow rate, the compressor power, the condenser duty and the volumetric flow rates entering the two expansion valves.
models.authors: N. Paulus (ULiège, repetition assistant); B. Dechesne (ULiège, repetition assistant); S. Quoilin (ULiège, course Thermodynamique appliquée)

models.name: heat_pump_scroll_compressor_data_check
models.title: Scroll-compressor heat pump on R407C: data consistency check
models.summary: Vapour-compression heat-pump operating point on R407C rebuilt from the capacities and powers announced by a scroll-compressor manufacturer: mass flow rate, swept volume, compressor duties, isentropic efficiency of the compressor and global isentropic efficiency of the machine, compared with the announced data.
models.tags: refrigeration;heat pump;scroll compressor;data consistency check;isentropic efficiency;volumetric efficiency;zeotropic blend;exercise
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: aircooled_chiller_refsim
models.title: Air-cooled water chiller, reference simulation model
models.summary: Reference simulation model of an air-cooled water chiller of the ULiège model bank: a scroll compressor described in four steps (suction heating-up, isentropic compression, isochoric compression, discharge cooling-down) with all its heat transfers represented by a fictitious wall of uniform temperature, an air-cooled condenser whose fan is controlled on the condensing temperature, and a water-supplied evaporator, both heat exchangers being described by three thermal resistances in series referred to their nominal flows.
models.tags: chiller;air-cooled condenser;scroll compressor;compressor heat transfer;fictitious wall;isochoric compression;fan control;condensing temperature control;part load;cascade of compressors;thermal resistances;reference model
models.authors: Vlad Teodorese (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); Jean Lebrun (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: rankine_cycle_60mw
models.title: Rankine cycle of a 60 MW steam power plant
models.summary: Simple Rankine cycle of a 60 MW steam plant (70 bar, 500 °C, 0.2 bar condenser): steam flow rate, boiler power, cooling-water flow rate, cycle efficiency, back-work ratio; state points as arrays for the diagrams.
models.authors: TBD

models.name: rankine_cycle_regenerative_extraction
models.title: Steam Rankine cycle with regenerative extraction
models.summary: 60 MW steam plant (70 bar, 500 C, 0.1 bar condenser) with a regenerative steam extraction at 25 bar to an open feedwater heater: steam and extraction flow rates, boiler power, cooling-water flow rate, plant thermal efficiency; state points as arrays for the diagrams.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: steam_power_plant_elementary
models.title: Elementary steam power plant (component balances)
models.summary: Steam power plant analysed component by component (pump, economiser, steam generator, turbine, condenser) from seven given state points with pressure drops, a thermal loss and significant kinetic energies: turbine power, component heat rates, cooling-water flow rate and overall cycle efficiency.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège course MECA0002 — Thermodynamique appliquée, session R3 2022-2023; companion session sheet lists S. Quoilin and the repetiteurs N. Paulus, B. Dechesne)

models.name: cpbar_combustion_products
models.title: cpbar: mean specific heat of CmHn combustion products (function library)
models.summary: Three EES routines of the ULiege combustion library (cpbar, gamma, mmprod) returning the mean specific heat, the specific-heat ratio and the molar mass of the combustion products of a CmHn fuel in simplified air, between two temperatures, for complete combustion, incomplete combustion (with unburned-CO losses) or pure air.
models.tags: combustion;mean specific heat;flue gas;fuel-air ratio;excess air;incomplete combustion;unburned CO losses;function library
models.authors: P. Ngendakumana (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: octane_combustion_400pct_air
models.title: Combustion of octane with 400 % theoretical air
models.summary: Octane burned with 400 % theoretical air in steady flow: adiabatic flame temperature from the first law on the combustion reaction (formation enthalpies), fuel-air ratio and stoichiometric dosage; excess-air effect on the flame temperature.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège, course Thermodynamique appliquée MECA0002 repetition team)

models.name: diesel_engine_excess_air_exhaust_analysis
models.title: Diesel engine: excess air and useful power from exhaust-gas analysis
models.summary: Combustion of diesel fuel (CH_n, n fitted from C/H mass fractions) with excess air; the excess air follows from the fuel-air ratio and the useful power from the five-box energy balance of the course, with the products brought to the exhaust temperature of 432 °C.
models.tags: combustion;diesel engine;exhaust gas analysis;excess air;fuel-air ratio;exercise
models.authors: TBD (ULiège, MECA0002 Thermodynamique appliquée, course of S. Quoilin)

models.name: steam_turbine_exergy_balance
models.title: Steam turbine exergy balance
models.summary: Second-law (exergy) analysis of a steam turbine of a ULiège course exercise: steam enters at 3 MPa and 450 °C at 8 kg/s, leaves at 0.2 MPa and 150 °C and loses 300 kW to an ambient at 100 kPa and 25 °C; the model gives the actual and the maximum (reversible) power, the second-law efficiency, the exergy destruction and the specific flow exergy at the inlet.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège, course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002)

models.name: two_tanks_connected_valve_r12
models.title: Two rigid tanks connected by a valve: change of quality of R12
models.summary: Two rigid tanks of 200 L connected by a valve: tank A holds an R12 liquid-vapour mixture at 25 C (10 % liquid and 90 % vapour in volume) and tank B is empty; opening the valve lets saturated vapour into B at constant temperature until the pressures are equal. The model gives the initial and the final quality of tank A (change of +6.67 percentage points) and the liquid/vapour distribution of the whole volume.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège, course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002)

models.name: iron_block_quench_water_tank
models.title: Iron block quenched in a water tank (exergy destruction)
models.summary: Closed-system second-law exercise: a 5 kg iron block at 350 degC quenched in 100 kg of water at 30 degC in an insulated rigid tank; the first law gives the final equilibrium temperature and the exergy balance of the isolated system gives the exergy destruction (wasted work potential).
models.authors: TBD (ULiège, course Thermodynamique appliquée; the companion course files name S. Quoilin and the repetition assistants N. Paulus and B. Dechesne)

models.name: two_tanks_max_work_air
models.title: Maximum work from two air tanks at 900 K and 300 K
models.summary: Two rigid vessels of 30 kg of air at 900 K and 300 K are coupled by a heat engine; the reversible (maximum work) end state is computed from the entropy balance of the extended system: both vessels end at the geometric mean temperature 519.6 K and the engine delivers 3.60 MJ.
models.tags: exergy;maximum work;reversible process;rigid tank;ideal gas;entropy balance;heat engine;exercise
models.authors: TBD (ULiège, course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002)

models.name: methane_tank_evaporation
models.title: Evaporation of liquid methane in a tank
models.summary: Liquid methane at 500 kPa in a tank evaporates due to heat input (level drop of 30 mm per hour); the model computes the evaporated mass and the volumetric flow rate of the gas leaving a heater at 500 kPa and 275 K.
models.authors: TBD

models.name: rigid_tank_water_mixture
models.title: Rigid tank with a liquid-vapour water mixture
models.summary: A 1 m^3 rigid vessel contains 4 kg of water in liquid-vapour equilibrium at 6 bar: quality of the mixture from the average specific volume, masses and volumes of the liquid and vapour phases, saturation temperature.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège, course Thermodynamique appliquée MECA0002 repetition team)

models.name: nonideal_gas_isothermal_work
models.title: Isothermal expansion of a non-ideal gas: unit of k and boundary work
models.summary: A gas obeying the equation of state v*(P + k/v^2) = R*T expands isothermally from 2 m^3 to 4 m^3; the model gives the unit of the parameter k, the final pressure and the boundary work, computed with an EES definite integral and with the closed form (the two must agree).
models.tags: equation of state;non-ideal gas;boundary work;isothermal;definite integral;dimensional analysis;exercise
models.authors: TBD (ULiège, course Thermodynamique appliquée MECA0002 repetition team)

models.name: brineprop_secondary_refrigerants
models.title: BrineProp: thermophysical properties of aqueous secondary refrigerants (function library)
models.summary: Single EES procedure BRINEPROP of the ULiège BrineProp library: freezing point, density, specific heat, thermal conductivity and dynamic viscosity of eleven aqueous secondary refrigerants (EG, PG, EA, MA, GL, NH3, K2CO3, CaCl2, MgCl2, NaCl, KAc) as a function of mass concentration and temperature, from an 18-term polynomial read in two coefficient lookup tables.
models.fluids: aqueous solutions EG, PG, EA, MA, GL, NH3, K2CO3, CaCl2, MgCl2, NaCl, KAc (secondary refrigerants)
models.tags: secondary refrigerant;brine;glycol;density;specific heat;thermal conductivity;dynamic viscosity;freezing point;empirical correlation;function library;model bank
models.authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory; the EES help file of the library credits its 1997 edition and refers to IIR thermo-physical data but names no person; the inventory attributes the library to the laboratory, J. Lebrun et al.)

models.name: pipe_pressure_drop_colebrook
models.title: Pipe pressure drop with the Colebrook-White friction factor
models.summary: Friction pressure drop of n-pentane in a straight pipe (16 mm diameter, 10 m): Darcy friction factor from the implicit Colebrook-White equation checked against an explicit approximation, linear and total pressure drop, dynamic pressure.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: chilled_water_cooling_coil
models.title: Chilled-water air cooling coil, dry and wet regimes
models.summary: Chilled-water air cooling coil (series air/wall/water resistances): dry regime by counterflow epsilon-NTU, condensation-risk check, wet regime by wet-bulb effectiveness with contact-factor outlet state and condensate flow.
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: air_handling_unit_moist_air
models.title: Air handling unit with moist-air conditioning
models.summary: Room supplied with outdoor air through an air handling unit: supply state from the room sensible and moisture loads, cooling coil by contact effectiveness with post-heating; computes coil capacity, post-heating power and condensate flow.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: cooling_coil_condensate_ratio
models.title: Condensate ratio and dry-air flow at a cooling coil, and a counter-flow recuperator
models.summary: Revision exercise with two questions on one heat-pump cycle: (1) a 7 kW cooling coil that dehumidifies air from 28 C/80 % RH to 13 C saturated, solved with two first-law methods (humid-air enthalpies neglecting the condensate, or separate dry-air/vapour/condensate terms), giving the condensate-to-dry-air ratio and the dry-air flow; (2) a counter-flow R113 recuperator of effectiveness 60 % with 5 kPa pressure drops on both sides, giving the outlet temperature T10.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège course MECA0002; inventory suggests S. Quoilin with repetition assistants N. Paulus and B. Dechesne)

models.name: adiabatic_humidifier_simplified
models.title: Adiabatic humidifier, simplified model (effectiveness-NTU)
models.summary: Adiabatic (evaporative) humidifier on humid air: heat and moisture transfer effectiveness from an NTU whose conductance follows power laws in the air and water flow rates (laboratory identification); exit air state and fraction of the supplied water evaporated.
models.authors: Jean Lebrun (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: cooling_coil_with_control_simplified
models.title: Cooling coil with control, simplified model (contact temperature)
models.summary: Simplified cooling and dehumidifying coil of an air handling unit from the ULiège model bank: the refrigerant side is not modelled and the coil is represented by a contact temperature (approach fraction set by the contact-factor effectiveness), driven by a bounded proportional control law on the exhaust air temperature; computes the exhaust air state and the total, sensible and latent cooling powers.
models.tags: cooling coil;air handling;contact factor;control;dehumidification;part load;simplified model;reference model
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); Jean Lebrun (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: cooling_coil_refsim
models.title: Cooling coil RefSim model, dry and wet regimes (one zone)
models.summary: Reference simulation model of a cooling and dehumidifying coil from the ULiège model bank: a one-zone counter-flow exchanger in which the fully dry and the fully wet regimes are described simultaneously and the regime of largest capacity is kept (Braun hypothesis); AU is the series of the air-side, metal and refrigerant-side resistances, the wet regime uses a fictitious perfect gas at the wet-bulb temperature and a fictitious semi-isothermal contact surface, and the secondary refrigerant properties come from the BrineProp library.
models.tags: cooling coil;air handling;dehumidification;dry regime;wet regime;wet bulb;contact temperature;Braun hypothesis;fictitious perfect gas;secondary refrigerant;brine;ethylene glycol;reference model
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); Jean Lebrun (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: two_speed_cooling_tower
models.title: Two-speed cooling tower (regimes and mean fan power vs water set-point)
models.summary: Evaporative cooling tower with a two-speed fan, each regime rated with the epsilon-NTU method on a fictitious dry fluid following the wet-bulb temperatures of the moist air; returns the outlet temperatures, heat rejected and weighted-mean fan powers for a given water outlet set-point.
models.authors: ULiège MSTh course (J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: cooling_tower_condenser_water
models.title: Cooling tower for the condenser water of a steam power plant
models.summary: Level-1 mass (dry air, water) and energy balances of a direct-contact cooling tower cooling condenser water from 65 °C to 30 °C with ambient air: air volume flow rate, make-up water flow rate and condenser heat rate.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège course Thermodynamique appliquée, S. Quoilin; repetition assistants N. Paulus and B. Dechesne per companion metadata)

models.name: cooling_tower_direct_contact_refsim
models.title: Direct-contact cooling tower, reference simulation model
models.summary: Reference simulation model of a direct-contact (evaporative) cooling tower from the ULiège model bank: a counter-flow exchanger between the water and the air leaving the tower saturated, the air side described by a fictitious fluid defined at the wet-bulb temperature (the same theory as the wet cooling coil); the dry heat transfer coefficient, the air-side pressure drop and the fan over-pressure are referred to the nominal conditions and both flow rates and the fan speed act on them.
models.tags: cooling tower;direct contact;evaporative cooling;wet bulb;fictitious fluid;Merckel;counter-flow;air side pressure drop;fan;water consumption;reference model
models.authors: Cleide Da Silva (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); Jean Lebrun (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: moist_air_cooling_coil_contact_factor
models.title: Moist-air cooling coil with contact factor
models.summary: Moist air cooled over a coil of given mean surface temperature: contact factor applied to temperatures and humidity ratios, total/sensible/latent heat per kg of dry air and condensate mass.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: moist_air_room_psychrometrics
models.title: Moist air in a room: humidity ratio, enthalpy and dew point
models.summary: Room of 5 m x 5 m x 3 m filled with air at 25 C and 75 % relative humidity at 100 kPa: partial pressures, humidity ratio, specific enthalpy per kg of dry air, masses of dry air and of water vapour, and dew-point temperature of the room air; every quantity is computed both with the course relations and with the EES property functions.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002 - see README 'Source and attribution')

models.name: moist_air_adiabatic_mixing
models.title: Adiabatic mixing of room air and outdoor air (moist air)
models.summary: Room air (dry-bulb/wet-bulb given) mixed adiabatically with outdoor air (temperature and relative humidity given): dry-air and vapour mass balances and a first-law balance give the humidity ratio and specific enthalpy of the supply state, plus its temperature, dew point and relative humidity.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002 - see README 'Source and attribution')

models.name: psychrometric_mixer_condensation
models.title: Psychrometric mixer with condensation: room air mixed with outdoor air
models.summary: Room air (20 degC dry bulb, 19.2 degC wet bulb) mixed adiabatically with outdoor air (0 degC, 90 % relative humidity, 300 g/s of dry air) at 101 325 Pa; the mixture falls below saturation, so the balances of the dry air, of the water (with a condensate term) and of the energy give the temperature of the saturated mixture and the condensate flow rate.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002 - see README 'Source and attribution')

models.name: adiabatic_saturation_wet_bulb
models.title: Adiabatic saturation and wet-bulb temperature of moist air
models.summary: Air at 25 degC dry bulb and 15 degC wet bulb at 1 atm: specific humidity, relative humidity and specific enthalpy of the moist air per kg of dry air, obtained with the adiabatic-saturation formula of the course (mass and energy balances of a wet-bulb thermometer, constant heat capacities) and cross-checked with the EES property functions HumRat, RelHum and enthalpy.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002 - see README 'Source and attribution')
